sentences.text:
Respondent(s)
 Through: Mr. Bhanu Jasrotia, Ga for R-1 to 4.

Mr. Sumant Sudan, Advocate vice
 Mr. Vishal Sharma, Dsgi for R-5.

Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice M A Chowdhary, Judge
 Order

1. The respondent-Collectorate in para 6 of its reply to the contents of paras 15 & 16 of the writ petition has submitted that proceedings in the instant case except final award have been conducted under the provisions of J&K Land Acquisition Act; that the draft award had been prepared in the year 2006-07 and 80% of the compensation has been disbursed among the interested land owners,
however, the State Vigilance Organization had seized the original acquisition proceedings record in the instant case, on the basis of a complaint lodged by some affected persons.

2. Learned counsel for the respondent-Collectorate submits at the Bar that the final award by the Collector could not be passed in view of the record having been seized by the State Vigilance Organization, who has been issued reminders by the Collector from time to time.
3. Learned counsel for the respondent No. 5 submits that respondent No. 5 has already deposited whole of the amount as per the draft award with the Collectorate.

4. Be that as it may, the land owners should not suffer for any inquiry being conducted by the State Vigilance Organization and their case with regard to compensation should be finalized, so that they are not deprived of the compensation, to which they are entitled for their land having been acquired for the construction of Ramban-Gool Road.
5.

Viewed, thus, the Collector is given last and final opportunity to finalize the land acquisition by passing a final award within a period of six weeks from the date of receipt of a certified copy of this Mohd. Sikander vs Ut Of J&K & Ors on 8 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/49601356/
1 order, failing which, the Collector shall remain present in person before this Court on the next date of hearing to explain as to why this order has not been complied with.
6. Needless to mention that the State Vigilance Organization (now ACB) shall provide access to the record seized, so as to facilitate the Collector to finalize the award without any hindrance.
7.
